scripts.build: FICUS_CLI_VERSION=${FICUS_CLI_VERSION:-dev} FICUS_CLI_COMMIT=${FICUS_CLI_COMMIT:-$(git rev-parse --short HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo dev)} FICUS_CLI_BUILD_DATE=${FICUS_CLI_BUILD_DATE:-$(git show -s --format=%cI HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo dev)} node -e "const fs=require('fs');fs.writeFileSync('src/build-info.generated.ts', 'export const generatedBuildInfo = '+JSON.stringify({version:process.env.FICUS_CLI_VERSION,commit:process.env.FICUS_CLI_COMMIT,buildDate:process.env.FICUS_CLI_BUILD_DATE}, null, 2)+' as const\n')" && bun build src/index.ts --outfile=dist/ficus.js --target=bun && rm -rf dist/skills && mkdir -p dist/skills && cp -R ../../external/skills/. dist/skills/ && node -e "const f='dist/ficus.js';require('fs').writeFileSync(f,'#!/usr/bin/env bun\n'+require('fs').readFileSync(f))" && chmod +x dist/ficus.js
